tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi de kho na nyid gsal bar byed pa mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog ces bya ba bzhugs so/

/ ka1 mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba/ （1ba）༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi de kho na nyid gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig brten na 'khor ba'i 'jigs 'phrog zhi bde'i dpal gyis tshim par mdzad/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas dpag yas skye dgu'i nyer mtsho'i gzhi/ /shes bya'i gnas rnams ji bzhin thugs chud 'gro nang chos char 'bebs pa'i rten/ /'phags pa kun gyi dgongs pa rdzogs mdzad rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ rang bzhin 'od gsal sgrib gnyis dri mas dben| so so rang rig spros pa kun bral yang*/ dus gsum chos kun ma 'dres so sor mkhyen/ /yon tan kun gyi mthar son thub dbang rgyal/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba ring du spangs kyang nyon mongs 'gro la thugs rjes bcings/ /chos kun gnyis su med par gzigs kyang bden gnyis rnam dbye gsal bar ston/ /zhi ba'i dbyings la mnyam par bzhag kyang sprul pa stong gis lo ga sgrol/ /bdag 'dzin bag chags bcas pa spangs kyang 'gro kun bdag gir mdzad la 'dud/ /'gro kun chos kyis phongs pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /gsung rab rin chen rnam bshad rgyal mtshan gyi/ /rtse mor 'god mdzad rgya bod mkhas pa'i tshogs/ /rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis legs par mchod/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'di mkhas mang gis/ /'grel pas gsal bar byas pa yod mod kyi/ /bdag kyang dam pa'i rjes su 'jug 'dod cing*/ /rang blo spel dang gzhan gyis bskul ba'i phyir/ /nyung ngu'i tshig gis rgya che'i don ston pa/ /bstan bcos chen po'i snying po mdor bsdus zhig /rgya bod mkhas pa du ma'i legs bshad kyi// rgyan gyi rnam par spras 'di bri bar bya/ / ka2 gzhung gi don bshad pa las/ kha1 mngon par rtogs pa brgyad bshad pa/ 'dir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don bsdus pa mngon par rtogs pa brgyad don bdun cu dang bcas pa gsal bar brjod par bya'o/

/de'ang sher phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed kyi blo gang zhig srid zhi'i pha rol du son pa/ dbye na/ dbyings rang bzhin rnam dag rten gyi sher phyin/ brten pa gzhung*| lam/ 'bras bu'i sher phyin dang bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ chos kyi dbyings te sher phyin gyi rten byed pas btags so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sher phyin ston pa'i mdo bstan bcos rnams te sher phyin rjod byed yin pas der btags so/ / gsum pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang*/ nyan rang gi lam rnams te/ sher phyin snga ma'i 'bras bu （2na）yin pa dang*/ sher phyin phyi ma'i rgyu yin pa dang sher phyin gyi 'khor yin pas der btags so/ /bzhi pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes te 'di kho na sher phyin dngos yin zhing*/ slob lam na shes rab yod kyi sher phy-in med do/ /de bzhin du slob lam na sbyin pa sogs lnga yod kyi sbyin pa'i phar phyin sogs lnga med/ slob dpon seng bzang dang slob dpon zla grags bzhed do// sher phyin de dag mngon rtogs brgyad kyi sgo nas ston pa las/dang po rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid/ chos thams cad bden pa'i skye med du rtogs shing don gnyis mthar thug pa'i rig pa/ dbye na/ mnyam bzhag ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen dang*/ rjes thob ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen gnyis so| |'di gnyis blo ngo bo gcig gis chos nyid dang chos can mkhyen pa'i cha nas bzhag la/ slob dpon seng bzang ni mnyam bzhag gis thams cad mkhyen/ de'i 'og tu rjes thob kyis dus gsum gyi dngos po thams cad kyi rnam pa shar nas mkhyen par bzhed/ sa mtshams sangs rgyas kyi sa nyid na yod do/ /gnyis pa lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ lam gsum bden pa'i rang bzhin med par mngon sum gyis rtogs shing smin rdzogs ma sbyangs par yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum du mi byed par gzhan don byed pa'i slob lam/ dbye na mnyam bzhag ji lta ba mkhyen pa dang*/

rjes thob ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i lam gnyis so/ / dang po ni byang sems 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes so| |gnyis pa ni/ byang sems 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag gis zin pa'i rjes thob kyi ye shes rnams so/ /sa drug pa man gyi rjes thob rgya yan rnams dang*/ ye shes kyis ma zin pa'i snyoms 'jug dgu lam shes min no/ /sa mtshams byang 'phags kyi sa bcu nyid na yod/ gsum pa gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gzhi bdag med par mngon sum gyis rtogs shing spangs rtogs nyi tshe bar gyur pa'i rig pa/ dbye na nyan rang 'phags pa'i lam drug go /sa mtshams kyang de nyid na yod/ gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum la mtshan mar 'dzin pa tsam ni theg chen gyi'ang sa bdun pa man chad na yod do/ /bzhi pa rnam kun mngon rdzogs kyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ mkhyen pa gsum gyi rnam pa rnams bsdus te sgom pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor/ dbye na nyi shu 'og tu 'chad/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam chung ngu nas rgyun mtha'i bar thams cad na yod do/ /lnga pa rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom tshogs lam las rab tu gyur pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor/ dbye na rtse mo bdun 'og tu 'chad/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod nas rgyun mtha'i bar thams cad na yod do| |drug pa mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bsdus nas rim gyis sgom pa'i rnal 'byor/（2ba ）dbye na/ mthar gyis bya ba/ bslab pa/ sgrub pa gsum mo/ /sa mtshams theg chen kyi tshogs lam chung ngu nas rgyun mtha'i bar thams cad na yod do/ / bdun pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom bsgoms mthar thug pa'i rnal 'byor/ /dbye na 'og tu 'chad/ sa mtshams rgyun mtha' nyid na yod/ mkhyed gsum bsdus sgom gyi don ni yul gzhi lam rnam pa gsum bdag gnyis kyis stong par shes shing yul can mkhyen pa gsum kun rdzob tu rgyu 'bras blang dor du gnas shing don dam par skye med du shes nas cir yang mi 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis sgom pa yin la/

de dang dmigs rnam mi mthun pa'i phyir byang sems kyi rjes thob rgya yan dang*/ snyoms 'jug zhi rags kyi rnam pa can brgyad dang*/ mnyam bzhag gis ma zin pa'i 'gog snyoms ni sbyor bzhi gang yang ma yin par sems so/ /brgyad pa chos sku'i mtshan nyid/ sbyor bzhi'i 'bras bu mthar thug dbye na sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las lnga'o/ /sa mtshams sangs rgyas kyi sa nyid na yod do/ / kha2 don bdun cu rgyas par bshad pa las/ skabs dang po/ rnam mkhyen bshad pa/ mngon rtogs brgyad po de dag bdun cu'i sgo nas ston pa la brgyad las/ dang po rnam mkhyen gyi chos bcu bshad pa las/ dang po sems bskyed la spyir sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid/ byang chub don gnyer gyi sems/ dbye na gsum las| dang po nyan thos kyi sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid/ rang don du nyan thos kyi byang chub don gnyer gyi sems/ gnyis pa rang sangs rgyas kyi sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid/ rang don du rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub don gnyer gyi sems/ gsum pa skabs su babs pa theg chen sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub don gnyer gyi sems/ gzhan don ni bsdus na gdul bya myang 'das la 'god pa/ phye na ser sna can sbyin pa la 'god pa sogs drug rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni bsdus na sher phyin/ phye na phar phyin drug go / theg chen sems bskyed la dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas smon 'jug gnyis so/ /'di gnyis bod kyi mkhas pa 'ga' zhig mi 'gal bar bzhed/ rgya gar gyi bstan bcos rnams las 'gal bar byas pa mang du snang*/ de gnyis kyi khyad par la paṇḍi ta chen po rnams kyis bzhed lugs mi 'dra ba mang du snang bas/ rang gang mos kyi rjes su 'brang zhing*/ 'grel chen dang*/ spyod 'jug dang*/ bslab btus gsum las 'di ltar gsal te/ smon pa sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub don gnyer gyi so skye'i sems gang zhig

byang sems kyi sdom pa dang mi ldan pa'i gnas skabs kyis bsdus pa/ 'jug pa sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa'i phyir bslab pa sgrub par 'dod pa'i sems gang zhig byang sems kyi sdom pa dang ldan pa'i gnas skabs （3na）kyis bsdus pa/ thob tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ brda byung dang*/ don dam sems bskyed gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub don gnyer sems gang zhig rnam par rig byed las thob pa yin la ming gzhan kun rdzob sems bskyed zer/ gnyis pa ni/ snying rje chen pos zin pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /grogs kyi sgo nas dbye na nyer gnyis/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi lam thams cad na yod/ zhar la byang sems kyi sdom pa'i mtshan nyid theg chen slob pa'i rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i tshul khrims/ dbye na gnyis las| dang po byang sems kyi brda byung gi sdom pa'i mtshan nyid/ byang sems kyi spang bya gzhi dang bcas pa spong ba'i sems dpa' dbang rgyun chags rnam par rig byed las thob pa/ gnyis pa byang sems kyi chos nyid kyis thob pa'i sdom pa'i mtshan nyid/ byang sems kyi spang bya gzhi dang bcas pa spong ba'i sems dpa' dbang rgyun chags bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis thob pa/ dbye na bsam gtan dang zag med kyi sdom pa gnyis yod cing*/ dang po drod nas thob la/ gnyis pa mthong lam nas thob bo/ brda byung sdom pa la/ sdom pa'i/ dge ba chos sdud kyi/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims gsum yod cing*/ tshogs lam chung ngu nas thob bo/ /chos gnyis pa 'dir smos theg chen gdam ngag gi mtshan nyid/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par byed pa'i thabs ston pa'i ngag sangs rgyas kyis dngos su 'doms pa/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' yang 'dir dngos su 'doms pa yin no/ /ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na gnyis las/ dang po ni 'dir smos gdams pa'i gdam ngag gi mtshan nyid/

spyan gang zhig thob zin gyi yon tan ma nyams par skye ba'i don du 'doms pa/ gnyis pa 'dir smos rjes bstan gyi gdam ngag mtshan nyid/ spyan gang zhig sngar ma thob pa'i yon tan thob pa'i don du 'doms pa/ sa mtshams gdam ngag dngos sangs rgyas kyi gsung yin pas sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus/ nyan pa po tshogs lam chen po chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin thob pa nas sa bcu skye ba gcig gis thaugs pa la gnas pa'i bar rnams so| |chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ btags pa'i dngos po la sems rtse gcig pa chos 'dzin pa dran pa dang mtshungs ldan no/ /tshogs lam chen pos thob bo/ /gdam ngag gi yul bcu'i dang po theg chen sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ smon 'jug sems bskyed kyis dam bcas pa'i don nyams su len pa'i bya ba/ dbye na bzhi 'og tu 'chad/ gnyis pa dmigs yul bden pa la bzhi las/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i mtshan nyid/ zag bcas 'bras bsdus/ kun 'byung bden pa'i mtshan nyid/ sdug bden skyed byed kyi zag bcas gang zhig sdug bden 'ba' （3ba ）zhig pa min pa| 'gog bden gyi mtshan nyid/ zag bcas nye bar zhi ba'i 'dus ma byas gang zhig lam bden gyi bral 'bras su gyur pa/ lam bden gyi mtshan nyid/ nyon mongs pa'i zag med 'dus byas/ rten dkon mchog gsum la/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid/ skyabs gnas gang zhig don gnyis mthar phyin pa/ chos dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid/ skyabs gnas gang zhig 'gog lam gang rung yin pa/ dge 'dun dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid / skyabs gnas gang zhig rig grol gyi yon tan brgyad ldan gyi byang sems/ theg dman gyi 'gog lam dang*/ gdam ngag ni 'dir skyabs gnas min no/ /ma zhen pa'i brtson 'grus gyi mtshan nyid| sgo gsum bden pa'i ngo bo nyid med par shes nas yum gyi sgrub pa la spro ba'i sems pa/ m-i ngal ba'i brtson 'grus kyi mtshan nyid/ chos thams cad rlom sems byar med par shes nas yum gyi sgrub pa la spro ba'i sems pa/

lam yongs su 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus kyi mtshan nyid/ chos thams cad bden pa'i skye med du shes nas yum gyi sgrub pa la spro ba'i sems pa/ spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ bdag rkyen rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi las yul mthong ba/ dbye na/ lnga las/ sha'i spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi la brten nas dpag tshad brgya nas stong gsum tshun chad kyi gzugs rnams ma 'dres par mthong ba'i shes pa/ lha'i spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi la brten nas phyogs bcu'i sems can dpag tu med pa'i 'chi 'pho skye ba mthong ba'i shes pa/ shes rab kyi spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi la brten nas chos dbyings mngon sum gyis rtogs pa'i ye shes/ chos kyi spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi la brten nas 'phags pa'i gang zag gzhan gyi rgyud tshod rig pa'i shes pa/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi la brten nas chos thams cad mngon sum gyis rtogs pa'i shes pa/ sa mtshams sngar lam gzhan du ma zhugs pa'i dbang du byas na dang po gnyis tshogs kyi lam chen po nas/ gsum pa mthong lam mnyam bzhag nas/ bzhi pa mthong lam rjes thob nas/ lnga pa sa bdun pa nas thob bo/ /theg chen gyi mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi shin tu dag pa ba la brten nas zhes pa thams cad la sbyor/ yul mngon sum gyis mngon du gyur pa'i theg chen gyi rtogs pa| |mngon sum gyi don ni/ sgra don 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bral zhing yang dag kun rdzob tu mi slu ba la byed dgos so/ /dbye na drug las/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam 'phrul sna tshogs ston par nus pa'i theg chen gyi rtogs pa/ lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes kyi ma tshan nyid/ sgra sna tshogs nyan par nus pa'i theg chen gyi rtogs pa/ gzhan gyi sems shes pa'i mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid/

sems can gzhan gyi sems kyi spyod pa rig pa'i theg chen gyi rtogs pa| sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid/ sngon gyi mtha'i spyod pa rjes su dran pa'i theg chen gyi （4na ）rtogs pa/ lha'i mig gi mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gzhan gyi 'chi 'pho skye ba dang gzugs kyi phra rags rnams mngon sum du shes pa'i theg chen rtogs pa/ zag zad mngon shes gyi mtshan nyid/ 'khor ba las nges par 'byung ba'i thabs mngon sum du shes pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i rtogs pa/ sa mtshams sngar lam gzhan du ma zhugs na/ dang po lnga theg chen gyi tshogs lam chen pos thob par 'grel chen du bshad/ drug pa sa dang po nas thob par mdor bshad do/ /theg chen mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ zag med sgom lam ma skyes gong gi 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba gang zhig rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bgrod pa'i go skabs phye shul/ theg chen sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen mthong lam rdzogs pa'i rjes nas rnam mkhyen ma thob bar gyi dge ba gang zhig rtogs pa'i byang chub tu bgrod pa'i go skabs phye shul lo/ / chos gsum pa theg chen nges 'byed yan lag gi mtshan nyid/ theg chen thar pa cha mthun gyi rjes kyi sgom byung 'jig rten pa'i rtogs pa gang zhig theg chen mthong lam dang blo'i rnam pa rjes su mthun pa/ dbye na khyad par lnga lnga dang ldan pa'i drod rtse bzod mchog bzhi'o/ khyad par lnga ni/ mi rtag sogs bcu drug gis khyad par du byas pa'i bden bzhi sgyu ma lta bu la dmigs pa/ chos su mngon zhen med pa'i rnam pa/ theg pa gsum char gyi rtogs rigs tshang ba'i mthong lam gyi nyer len byed pa rgyu/ theg chen gyi chos ston pa'i dge bshes dang*/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab snying po chen po dang zung du 'jug pa'i thabs mkhas gnyis yongs 'dzin| rang gi mthong sgom lam gyis spong ba'i rtog pa bzhi'i ngor ldan pa ldan chos kyi khyad par de lnga'o/

/de la spyir rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ yul ji lta ba bzhin min par 'dzin pa'i blo/ dbye na gnyis las/ dang po gzung rtogs mtshan nyid/ spyi 'dzin gang zhig gzung ba'i yul can/ dbye na gnyis las/ dang po kun nas nyon mongs kyi gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid/ spyi 'dzin gang zhig 'khor ba'i yul can| gnyis pa rnam byang gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid/ spyi 'dzin gi gnyen po'i yul can no/ /gnyis pa 'dzin rtog gi mtshan nyid/ spyi 'dzin gang zhig 'dzin pa'i yul can/ dbye na gnyis las/ dang po rdzas 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ spyi 'dzin gang zhig rdzas 'dzin gyi yul can/ rdzas 'dzin ni so skye'i 'dzin pa'o/ / gnyis pa btags 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ spyi 'dzin gang zhig btags 'dzin gyi yul can/ btags 'dzin gyi 'phags pa'i 'dzin pa'o/ /rtog pa bzhi po de dag re re la dgag rtog dang sgrub rtog gnyis su yod cing*/ dang po ni/ gzung 'dzin de kho nar cir yang ma grub par rtog pa'i rnam pa can te sbyor lam mnyam bzhag na yod cing khyad chos kyi gtso bo yin/ gnyis pa ni/ kun rdzob tu gzung 'dzin du yod par rtog pa ste/ sbyor lam rjes thob na yod cing rang gi mthong sgom gyis spong ba tsam gyi sgo nas khyad chos yin no/ /chos bzhi pa la/ spyir rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs kyi mtshan nyid/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i （4ba）sems kyi chos dbyings gang zhig gnyen po dang phrad na glo bur gyi dri ma thams cad dang 'bral du rung ba/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la yod do/ /rgyas 'gyur rigs kyi mtshan nyid/ 'dus byas kyi dge ba gang zhig rdzaugs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur gyur pa/ 'dir smos sgrub pa yi rten rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs kyi mtshan nyid/ dri bcas sems kyi chos dbyings gang zhig theg chen sgrub pa'i dngos kyi rten gzhi yin pa/

ngo bo la dbye ba med kyang rten chos kyi sgo nas dbye na bcu gsum yod/ rten chos sgrub pa bcu gsum la/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam bzhi/ mthong sgom gnyis te rtogs pa'i chos drug gnyen po dang spong ba gnyis ni mthong sgom gyi bar chad med lam gyis bsdus te/ de dag skyes pa'i stobs kyis zhes pas so/ /spang gnyen skye 'gag gi rtog pa spangs pa'i sgrub pa ni sa brgyad pa nas yod de/ bri med 'phel ba med don dang zhes dang*/ sa bdun pa man chad na 'khor 'das la blang dor du 'dzin pa'i sa bon yod par bshad pas so/ /shes rab snying rtser bcas pa'i sgrub pa ni mthong lam mnyam bzhag nas yod de 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa la mi gnas pa'i mtshan nyid kyi shes rab dang thabs shes zhes/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*/ /snying rjes zhi la mi gnas dang*/ /zhes pa dang don gcig tu bshad pas so/ /slob ma thun mong min nyid kyi sgrub pa yang sa brgyad pa nas yod de/ sa brgyad pa la nyan thos la sogs pa dang thun mong ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lam la'o/ / zhes dang*/ sa bdun pa na 'bras bu la mtshan 'dzin gyi sa bon yod par bshad pas so/ /gzhan gyi don gyi go rim gyi sgrub pa ni sa dgu pa nas yod do/ / dgongs ldem dgongs kyi chos bstan pas gdul bya theg gsum la 'god pa ni/ 'bras bu rin chen sbyin byed gnas gcig cing*/ de sa dgu pa nas thob par yang byang chub thob dang zhes mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba sa dgu pa nas yod par bshad pas so/ /ye shes rtsol ba mi mnga' bar 'jug pa'i sgrub pa ni/ sa bcu pa na yod do/ /gzhan gyi don gyi ye shes 'byung zhes dang*/ sa bcu par 'phrin las phun tshogs la dbang thob par bshad pas so/ /'di sangs rgyas kyi sar slob dpon mi bzhed do/ /sgrub pa'i chos kyi gnas skabs zhes dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnam pa gsum zhes pas so/

/ sa mtshams ni theg chen tshogs lam chung ngu nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod de/ tshogs lam pa'i sgrub pa shugs la bstan pas so/ /chos lnga pa sgrub pa'i dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid/ sgrub pa po'i shes byar gyur pa/ dbye na bcu gcig las/ dang po dge ba'i mtshan nyid/ nyon mongs pa'i nyes pas ma gos pa'i rnam byang*/ dge ba'i las kyi mtshan nyid/ mi dge ba'i gnyen por gyur pa/ gnyis pa mi dge ba'i （5na ）mtshan nyid/ dge ba'i 'gal ba mi mthun phyaugs su gyur pa/ gsum pa lung ma bstan gyi las kyi mtshan nyid/ dge mi dge gang yang min pa'i las/ bzhi pa 'jig rten pa'i mtshan nyid/ sdug kun gang rung yin pa/ lnga pa 'jin rten las 'das pa'i mtshan nyid/ lam bden chos dbyings gang rung yin pa/ drug pa zag bcas gyi mtshan nyid/ zag pa'i sgo drug rung yin pa/ bdun pa zag med kyi mtshan nyid/ zag pa'i sgo drug gang yang min pa/ zag pa sgo drug ni/ zag pa'i bdag nyid/ zag pa dang 'brel ba/ zag pas bcings pa/ zag pa'i rjes su 'brel ba/ zag pa'i rjes su mthun pa/ zag pa'i rgyu las byung ba rnams so/ /dang po ni rtsa nyon nye nyon rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni nyon mongs de dag dang mtshungs ldan gyi shes pa dang*/ de dag skyai ba'i gnas mig sogs so/ /gsum pa ni nyon mongs mngon 'gyur rgyud la yod dus kyi dge ba'o// bzhi pa ni/ nyon mongs kyi sa bon dang ldan pa'i kun gzhi'o/ /lnga pa ni/ nyon mongs skye ba'i rgyu ste sbyor lam ma gtogs pa'i zag bcas thams cad do/ /drug pa ni sngar gyi las nyon gyis 'phangs shing mtshams sbyar ba'i phung po'i rgyun te dgra bcom tha ma'i gzugs kyi phung po tshun chad do/ /brgyad pa 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid/ rgyu rkyen las skyes pa/ dgu pa 'dus ma byas kyi mtshan nyid/ rgyu rkyen las ma skyes pa/ bcu pa mthun mong gi yon tan gyi mtshan nyid/ 'phags pa bzhi char gyi rgyud la yod pa'i yon tan/

bcu gcig pa mthun mong min pa'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na'i thugs rgyud la yod pa'i yon tan no| |dmigs pa'i sa mtshams 'khor 'das thams cad na yod do/ /chos drug pa sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba'i mtshan nyid/ sgrub pa po'i don du gnyer byar gyur pa/ dbye na gnyis las/ dang po sgrub pa'i gnas skabs kyi ched du bya ba'i mtshan nyid/ sgrub pa po'i gnas skabs kyi don du gnyer byar gyur pa/ tshogs lam chung ngu nas rgyun mtha'i bar gyi sems bskyed dang*/ spangs pa dang*/ rtogs pa gsum mo/ /gnyis pa sgrub pa'i mthar thug gi ched du bya ba'i mtshan nyid| sgrub pa po'i mthar thug gi don du gnyer byar gyur pa/ dbye na sangs rgyas pa'i sems bskyed dang*/ spangs pa dang*/ rtogs pa ste chen po gsum mo/ /chos bdun pa go cha'i sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ smon 'jug sems bskyed kyis dam bcas pa'i don nyams su len pa'i bsam pa'i brtson 'grus kyi bya ba/ dbye na phar phyin drug gi go sgrub drug gam/ de re re la drug drug tu phye bas so drug go |phar phyin drug la sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ gtong ba chos bzhi ldan/ chos bzhi ni/ mi mthun phyogs ser sna dang bral ba/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa/ sems can kyi 'dod pa rdzogs par byed pa/ sbyin pas bsdus nas theg pa gsum gyi skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du smin par byed pa gsum mo/ /de bzhin du （5ba ）tshul khrims phar phyin gyi mtshananyid/ spong ba'i sems pa chos bzhi ldan/ bzod pa'i phar phyin gyi mtshananyid/ mi 'khrugs pa chos bzhi ldan/ brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin gy-i mtshananyid/ dge ba la spro ba chos bzhi ldan/ bsam gtan phar phyin gy-i mtshan nyid/ sems rtse gcig pa chos bzhi ldan| shes rab kyi phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed chos bzhi ldan no/ /spyir phar phyin yin na/

rab kyi mthar thug par son pa yin dgos kyang*| 'dir theg chen sems bskyed dang 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'-i sbyin sogs drug la phar phyin drug tu rnam gzhag byas pa yin/ 'di'i phar phyin drug ka theg chen tshogs lam nas yod/ go sgrub kyi sa mtshams theg chen tshogs lam chung ngu nas rgyun mtha'i snga logs man chad na yod par bzhed do/ /chos brgyad pa 'jug pa'i sgrub pa'-i mtshananyid/ smon 'jug sems bskyed kyis dam bcas pa'i don nyams su len pa'i sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyi bya ba/ dbye na 'jug pa bsam gtan gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug phar phyin drug byang phyogs so bdun/ tshad med bzhi/ chos thams cad cir yang ma dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab/ 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i phyin drug ched du bya ba chen po gsum/ mngon shes drug rnam mkhyen rnams la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dgu'o/ /dang po drug ni/ 'jug pa de dag sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyis nyams su len pa yin la/ phyi ma gsum ni rim pa ltar chen po gsum thob pa'i don du sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyis lam nyams su len pa'i bya ba dang*/ mngon shes drug gi sgo nas sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyis sems can smin grol byed pa'i bya ba dang*/ rnam mkhyen thob pa'i don du sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyis nyams su len pa'i bya ba'o/ /sa mtshams theg chen sbyor lam drod nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod| chos dgu pa tshogs kyi sgrub pa'-i mtshananyid/ smon 'jug sems bskyed kyis dam bcas pa'i don nyams su len pa'i bya ba gang zhig rang 'bras byang chub chen po dngos su skyed nus/ dbye na tshogs bcu bdun bden par mi dmigs par nyams su len pa'i sgrub pa bcu bdun yod/ tshogs bcu bdun la ji snyed chen po'i tshogs ni tshor ba gsum ga sdug bsngal du mnyam par shes pa sogs khyad par drug dang ldan pa'i snying rjes te/

rgyan 'grel du sa brgyad par thob par bshad kyang 'dir drod nas thob par mngon no/ /phyin drug gi tshogs ni bshad zin pa nyid do/ /zhi gnas kyi tshogs la/ spyir zhi gnas ky-i mtshananyid/ nang gi dmigs pa la sems nye bar gtad pa'i bsam gtan/ ming gzhan gnas pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang rtse gcig pa zer/ 'dir zhi gnas kyi tshogs ni sems can thams cad kyi don sgrub par rtse gcig pa nyid la gsungs/ lhag mthong gi tshogs la/ spyir lhag mthong g-i mtshananyid/ chos yang dag par rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i blo/ 'dir lhag mthong gi tshogs ni chos thams cad stong nyid du rtogs pa'i shes rab bo/ /（shog grangs drug pa'i ma dpe ma tshang*/） skabs gnyis pa/ lam shes bshad pa/ （7na ）gnyis pa lam shes skye ba'i yul sems bskyed kyi mtshananyid/ theg chen sems bskyed gang zhig lam shes skye ba'i rkyen du gyur pa/ gsum pa lam shes skye ba'i rgyu rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs kyi mtshan nyid/ lam shes 'byung rung gi skyes bu'i rgyud kyi chos dbyings dri bcas/ 'dis theg pa gsum ga'i gang zag la khyab pas khyab pa zhes zer ro/ /bzhi pa lam shes kyi rang bzhin gyi mtshan nyid/ 'khor bar zhugs nas gzhan don mdzad pa'i phyir du dge ba'i rtsa ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs pa ched du gnyer nas mi spong ba'i 'phags pa slob pa'i mngon rtogs/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs pa'i mtshan nyid/ nyes spyod kun nas slong mi nus pa'i nyon mongs phra mo gang zhig theg chen 'phags pa'i thabs shes kyis zin pa/ 'di cung zad dpyad par bya'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs pa ni/ spyir rig pa yin dgos la/ de la sgrib pa yin min gnyis su nges so| |sgrib pa min na spang bya gtan min du 'gyur ba'i phyir sgrib pa yin la/ de la shes sgrib dang nyon sgrib gnyis su nges/ shes sgrib yin na dgra bcom pas ched du gnyer nas spangs par bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir nyon sgrib yin la/

de la kun btags dang lhan skyes gnyis su nges/ kun btags ni nyes spyod kun nas slong nus pas byang sems kyis kyang ched du gnyer nas spong dgos par byang sa dang*/ spyod 'jug la sogs mang po las bshad pa'i phyir 'di nyon mongs lhan skyes yin par nges so/ /de byang sems kyis ched du gnyer nas mi spaung gi sgom spang du gyur pa'i shes sgrib kyi zhar la spong ba yin no/ /de ltar yang kun las btus su sa bcu rnams su sgom pa'i lam la shes bya'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po sgom lam gyis nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po ni ma yin te/ de byang chub thob pa na nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa cig car spong stai zhes dang*/ tshig gsal du/ de kho na nyid ni gang zag la bdag med pa'i mtha' zhi ba nyid de mngon du mi byed pa ni sgom pas spang bar bya ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams ni mi spong ba'i phyir te/ de ma spangs pas na mya ngan las mi 'da' ste zhes so/ /lnga pa lam shes kyi byed las kyi mtshan nyid/ byang sems 'phags pas dge ba'i rtsa ba dang mtshungs ldan gyi nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis 'khor bar zhugs nas gzhan don mdzad pa'i nus pa/ chos gnyis pa nyan thos kyi lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i shes rab kyis bden bzhi'i rnam pa sum cu rtsa gsum bden par ma dmigs par mngon sum gyis rtogs pa'i slob lam/ bden bzhi'i rnam pa so gsum ni/ mi rtag du khaḥ bdag med| zhi ba'i rnam pa ste sdug bden gyi bzhi/ nad dang*/ 'bras/ zug ngu*/ sdig pa'i rnam pa ste kun 'byung bden pa'i bzhi/ pha rol dang*/ 'jig pa'i chos can dang （7ba ）g.yo ba dang*/ rab tu 'jig pa dang*/ nad 'go ba dang*/ 'tshe ba rnam pa ste bdun po sdug kun re re la bdun bdun sbyar bas bcu bzhi'o/ /bdag med| zhi ba/ dben pa/ stong nyid/ mtshan ma med pa/ smon pa med pa/ mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i rnam pa ste 'gog bden gyi bdun no/

/lam/ rigs pa/ sgrub pa/ nges par 'byin pa'i rnam pa ste lam bden gyi rnam pa bzhi rnams so/ / sa mtshams kyang byang sems 'phags pa'i lam thams cad na yod/ 'di'i skabs nas shes bya nyan thos kyi lam dang*/ de shes pa'i lam shes gnyis ka dngos su bstan/ rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gyi skabs nas theg chen gyi sbyor lam dngos su bstan nyan thos kyi sbyor lam shugs la bstan to/ /chos gsum pa rang rgyal gyi lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ kun rdzob tu rang rgyal lam gyi yon tan yar ldan du thob cing*/ don dam par cir yang ma dmigs par mngon sum gyis rtogs pa'i slob lam/ dbye na byang sems 'phags pa'i sa bcu/ sa mtshams kyang de nyid na yod/ gzhung nas rang rgyal lam gyi khyad par/ ngo bo rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gsum gyis bstan to/ /de la rang rgyal lam gyi khyad par gyi mtshan nyid/ nyan thos la med cing rang rgyal la yod pa'i yon tan/ dbye na gnyis las/ dang po lam bgrod pa'i khyad par gyi mtshan nyid/ srid pa tha ma pa'i tshe slob dpon la mi ltos par 'dod khams su rang rgyal rang gi byang chub mngon du byed pa/ gnyis pa chos ston pa'i khyad par gyi mtshan nyid/ ngag gi sgra med par lus kyis chos ston pas gdul bya'i rgyud la shes rab skyed par nus pa'i rang rgyal gyi yon tan/ khyad par snga ma rang rgyal thams cad la yod la/ phyi ma rang rgyal tshogs spyod 'ga' zhig la med de/ nyan thos srid pa lan bdun pa rang rgyal du gyur pa dag la de'i rgyu sngon gyi smon lam dang*/ gzung med rtogs pa'i ye shes med pa'i phyir dang*| lung las kyang rang rgyal sgra bcas su gtam glaing ba bshad la/ de nyid chos ston pa'ang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /snyam du sems so/ /gnyis pa so so'i mtshan nyid/ bem po bden med du rtogs shing rig pa bden med du ma rtogs pa'i blo gang zhig bem po bden med du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis/

sad par byas pa'i tshogs kyi dang*/ rang bzhin gyi dbang po 'bring gi ngag zhig la brten pa/ 'di'ang gtso cher bse ru lta bu'i dbang du byas so/ / gsum pa 'dir smos rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ sbyor lam gang zhig nyan thos kyi sbyo ra lam las don gzhan pa/ dbye na dngos bstan byang sems kyi sbyor lam dang*/ shugs bstan rang rgyal gyi sbyor lam gnyis so/ /chos bzhi pa byang sems kyi mthong lam phan yon dang bcas pa'i mtshan nyid| zag med sgom lam ma skyes gong gi 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rtogs pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bgrod pa'i go skabs phye shul tshe 'di phyi'i 'bras bu chen po dang （8na ）bcas pa/ dbye na bden pa bzhi po re re la chos bzod pa'i bzod pa/ /rjes su shes pa'i ye shes bzhi bzhi ste dngos su bcu drug yod do/ / de'ang chos mchog chen po'i rjes la sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes sdug bsngal mthong bas spang bar bya ba'i/ khams gsum gyi mthong spang nyer brgyad spong ba'i gnyen po ni sdug bsngal la chos bzod do| |de'i rjes la sdug bsngal mthong spang gis dag pa rtogs pa'i ye shes ni du khaḥ la chos shes so/ /de'i rjes la ye shes snga ma de gnyis 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi rgyur rtogs pa sdug bsngal la rjes bzod do/ /de'i rjes la rjes bzod de nyid/ nges par 'dzin pa ni sdug bsngal la rjes shes so/

/de bzhin du chos bzod gsum gyis bden pa so so'i khams gsum gyi mthong spangs nyer brgyad nyer brgyad gya bzhi spong*/ chos shes gsum gyis chos bzod gsum po'i rnam grol gyi lam mngon sum du byed/ rjes shes gsum gyis rang rang gi snga logs kyi chos bzod chos shais gnyis po 'phags pa'i chos phyi rnams kyi rgyur rtogs| rjes shes gsum gyis rang rang gi snga logs kyi rjes bzod nges par 'dzin no/ /bcu drug po rim pa bzhin du skye zhing*/ chos bzod chos shes gnyis bden bzhi'i chos dbyings rtogs par dmigs rnam gcig la/ chos bzod bar chad med lam dang*/ chos shes rnam grol gyi lam yin pa'i khyad par yod do/ / rjes bzod rjes shes gnyis chos dbyings rtogs pa'i ye shes la dmigs par dmigs rnam gcig cing*/ gsar du rtogs pa dang*/ de nyid kyi rgyun la 'dris par byed pa'i khyad par yod do/ /'di dag kun las btus kyi lugs yin zhing*/ 'grel chen las kyang bshad do/ /'on kyang slob dpon ni mthong lam skad cig ma gcig tu skye bar bzhed par snang ngo*/ /skabs 'dir 'ga' zhig rnam pa dngos su bstan/ 'ga' zhig phan yon gyi rnam pa mtshon nas bstan par 'grel chen las bshad do/ /sa mtshams sa dang po nyid na yod/ /chos lnga pa sgom lam gyi byed pa'i mtshan nyid/ theg chen sgom lam las gnas skabs sam mthar thug tu thob pa'i yon tan/ dbye na ku nas dul ba'i byed pa sogs drug las/ dang po ni sgom lam la rten sems las su rung bar gyur pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni sgom lam la brten nas nga rgyal dang bral ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sgom spang che 'bring dgu rim pa ltar spangs pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ phyi rol gyi gnod pas mi tshugs pa'o/ /lnga pa ni bla na med pa'i byang chub bo/ /drug pa ni sgom lam pa bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs sems can rnams kyis mchod pa bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa'o/

/sa mtshams dang po lnga sa gnyis pa yan chad na ci rigs par yod/ drug pa sgom lam pa gang bzhugs na yod do/ /chos drug pa mos pa yin la phyed pa'i sgom lam mtshan nyid/ byang sems kyi sgom lam zag bcas gang zhig yum yon tan can du （8ba ）nges par byas pa'i dngos po la de kho na ltar 'dzin pa/ dbye na gsum las/ dang po rang don mos pa'i mtshan nyid/ spyi mtshan de yin zhing sbyor bas rang don gtso bor sgrub pa/ sa mtshams sa gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa rnams kyi rjes thob na yod ces lung gi snye mar 'byung zhing*/ 'grel chen ltar na sa bdun pa'i bar na'ang yod par mngon te/ 'grel chen las/ bdag tu nga rgyal gyi sa bon ma zad pa nyid kyis dang po kho nar rang don gyi mos pa rnam pa dgu bstan ces bshad cing*| bdag tu nga rgyal gyi sa bon sa bdun pa'i bar du yod par mdo sde rgyan las bshad pas so/ /gnyis pa gnyis don mos pa'i mtshan nyid/ spyi mtshan de yin zhing sbyor bas gzhan don bar chad dang bcas par sgrub pa/ dbye na dgu sa mtshams sa lnga pa drug pa bdun pa gsum gyi rje thob na yod gsung ngo*/ /gsum pa gzhan don mos pa'i mtshan nyid/ spyi mtshan de yin zhing sbyor bas gzhan don bar chad med par sgrub pa/ dbye na dgu sa mtshams dag pa sa gsum gyi rjes thob na yod ces gsungs so/ /chos bdun pa mos pa'i phan yon gyi mtshan nyid/ mos pa las thob pa'i yon tan/ dbye na gsum las/ dang po bstod pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang don mos pa sgom pa'i byang sems spro ba skyed pa'i phyir du rang don mos pa las bsod nams dpag tu med pa 'byung bar ston pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi gsung don mthun| |dbye na dgu gnyis pa bskur ba'i mtshan nyid/ gnyis don mos pa sgom pa'i byang sems spro ba skyed pa'i phyir du gnyis don mos pa las bsod nams dpag tu med pa 'byung ba ston pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi gsung don mthun/

dbye na dgu gsum pa bsngags pa'i mtshan nyid/ gzhan don mos pa sgom pa'i byang sems spro ba skyed pa'i phyir du gzhan don mos pa las bsod nams dpag tu med pa 'byung bar ston pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi gsung don mthun/ dbye na dgu 'di dag chos shes mos pa gsum sgom pa'i byang sems la thugs dgyes pas gnas pa kho na yin gyi ngag min no zhes bshad kyang 'dir 'grel chen las*/ 'phags pa rnam par grol ba'i sdes/ byang chub sems dpa' la spro ba skyed par byed pa la legs so legs so zhes bya ba byin pas bstod pa dang*/ bskur ba dang*/ bsngags pa'i don nye bar sdud pa yin no zhes bshad do/ /zhes 'byung ba/ bstod pa la sogs pa 'di dag ni gong nas gong du bsod nams che ba nyid du bstan pas de'i rang bzhin don yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa tsam gyi mtshan nyid can yin gyi gcam gsag tu smra ba la sogs pa ni min no zhes gsungs pas/ mos pa nyer bdun la 'bras bu bsod nams chen po yod par ston pa'i mdo tshig nyer bdun po nyid bstod bskur bsngags pa dgu tshan gsum du bzhed pa yin no/ /gal te rtogs pa'i char bzhed nas rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid can yin gyi ngag tu brjod pa ni min no zhes gsungs par rigs pa las gcam gsag tu smra ba ni min no zhes gsungs so/ /chos brgyad pa bsngo ba yid la byed pa'i sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ byang sems kyi sgom lam zag bcas gang zhig dge ba gzhan don du rdzaugs pa'i byang chub kyi yan lag tu byed pa/ dbye na bcu gnyis las/ dang po khyad par can gyi bsngo ba'i mtshan nyid/ byang sems kyi sgom lam zag bcas gang zhig dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bar gsum （9na ）gyis bsdu pa'i skye 'phags kyi dge ba thams cad la thabs shes zung 'brel gyi rjes su yi rang sngon du btang nas yi rang gi dge ba sems can thams cad kyi don du bla med byang chub kyi yan lag tu byed pa/

gnyis pa mi dmigs pa'i bsngo ba'i mtshan nyid/ bsngo ba yid la byed pa'i sgom lam gang zhig 'og ma bdun la'ang sbyar ro/ / bsngo bya'i bsod nams de kho nar mi dmigs par rtogs pa/ gsum pa phyin ci ma log pa'i bsngo ba'i mtshan nyid/ sngo byed kyi sems de kho nar mi dmigs par rtogs pa/ bzhi pa dben pa'i bsngo ba'i mtshan nyid/ bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa'i sems pa dang de'i 'bras bu bsod nams gnyis bdag dang bdag gi bar ma grub par rtogs pa/ lnga pa sangs rgyas kyi bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi rang bzhin dran pa'i bsngo ba'i mtshan nyid/ bsngo bya bsngo ba sngo byed kyi sems rnams la sgyu ma lta bur yang zhen par byar med par rtogs pa/ drug pa thabs la mkhas pa'i bsngo ba'i/ phar phyin drug sgrub bzhin du bden par mi dmigs par rtogs pa/ bdun pa mtshan ma med pa'i bsngo ba'i mtshan nyid/ bsngo ba'i chos rnams stong nyid du zhen byar ma grub par rtogs pa/ brgyad pa sangs rgyas kyis snang ba'i bsngo ba'i mtshan nyid/ thabs shes zung du 'brel ba/ dgu pa khams gsum du ma rtogs pa'i bsngo ba'i mtshan nyid/ khams gsum bden par ma dmigs par rtogs pa/ /bcu pa bsod nams chen po 'byung ba'i bsngo ba chung ngu'i mtshan nyid/ byang sems kyi sgom lam zag bcas gang zhig stong gsum gcig gi sems can thams cad kyis dge ba bcu nas mngon shes lnga'i bar thob pa'i dge ba la thabs shes zung 'brel gyi yi rang sngon du btang nas yi rang gi dge ba mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub tu bsngos pas stong gsum sems can gyis chos lnga thob pa bas bsod nams che ba dang ldan pa/ bcu gcig pa bsod nams chen po 'byung ba'i bsngo ba 'bring gi mtshan nyid/ byang sems kyi sgom lam zag bcas gang zhig stong gsum gang gā'i rlung gi sems can thams cad kyis 'bras bu lnga thob pa'i dge ba la thabs shes zung 'brel gyi yi rang sngon du btang nas yi rang gi dge ba mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis byang chub tu bsngos pas stong gsum sems can thams cad kyis 'bras bu lnga thob pa bas bsod nams che ba dang ldan/

bcu gnyis pa bsod nams chen po 'byung ba'i bsngo ba chen po'i mtshan nyid/ byang sems kyi sgom lam zag bcas gang zhig stong gsum sems can thams cad gang gā'i rlung gi bye ma snyed kyi sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpar gyur pa rnams kyis stong gsum gzhan gyi sems can thams cad la bskal ba gang gā'i rlung gi bye ma snyed du dmigs bcas kyis sbyin pa btang ba'i bsod nams la thabs shes zung 'brel gyi yi rang sngon du btang nas yi rang gi dge ba mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyi byang chub tu bsngos pas byang sems de dag gi sbyin pa'i bsod nams las bsod nams shin tu che ba dang ldan pa/ bsngo ba bcu gnyis po 'di ngo bo gcig cing sa mtshams sa lhag ma dgu'o rjes thob na yod| 'di ni brgyad stong pa dang*/ 'grel chen gyi lugs yin gyi/ nyi khri las tha ma gsum 'di dang cung zad mi 'dra bar gsungs so/ /chos dgu pa rjes su yi rang ba yid la byed pa'i sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ byang sems kyi sgom lam zag bcas gang zhig rang bzhan gyi dge ba la dga' ba yang dag par sgom pa/ dbye na/ ma dor ma dmigs pa'i sgo nas yi rang ba dang*/ kun rdzob tu sgyu ma lta bur dmigs pa'i sgo nas yi rang ba gnyis so/ /sa mtshams gong dang 'dra/ byang sems kyi sgom lam zag bcas kyi mtshan nyid/（9ba）byang sems kyi sgom lam gang zhig gzung 'dzin gnyis snang yin pa/ sa mtshams slob dpon dang slob dpon chos kyi bshes gnyen gnyis kyis sa bcu pa man chad kyi rjes thob na yod par bzhed/ mdo sde rgyan dang 'phags pa thogs med kyis sa brgyad pa nas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyun mi chad du yod pas gzung 'dzin gnyis snang can gyi rjes thob med par bzhed do/ /chos bcu pa sgrub pa'i sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ byang sems kyi sgom lam zag med gang zhig rang gi ngos skal gyi spang byar gyur pa'i sgom spang gi dngos gnyen yin pa/

dbye na/ ngo bo/ khyad par/ rnam pa/ de rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud la 'jog tshul 'bras bu dang lngas bstan/ sa mtshams sa lhag ma dgu'i mnyam bzhag sbyor ba'i lam dang bar chad med pa'i lam rnams nyid na yod/ mtshan nyid sa mtshams de ltar yin par tshig gsal nas 'byung ngo*/ /chos bcu gcig pa rnam dag sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ byang sems kyi sgom lam zag med gang zhig rnam grol lam gyi char gyur pa/ dbye na/ sa lhag ma dgu'i rnam grol lam dgu yod cing*/ sa mtshams kyang de nyid na yod/ gzhung nas 'phags pa bzhi khar gyi rnam dag spros nas bstan/ de la nyan thos 'phags pa'i rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ rang gi spang bya nyon sgrib kyi sa bon las grol ba'i cha| dbye na/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i rnam grol gyi lam brgyad cu rtsa dgu dang*/ nyan thos kyi 'gog bden no/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ theg 'bring gi yon tan gang zhig nyon sgrib dang bem po bden 'dzin gyi rtog pa'i sa bon 'ga' zhig las grol ba/ dbye ba nyan thos dang mtshungs/ byang sems kyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ byang sems can kyi yon tan gang zhig sgrib gnyis kyi sa bon ci rigs pa las grol ba/ dbye na/ sa bcu'i rnam grol lam bcu dang*/ byang sems kyi 'gog bden no/ /'on kyang theg pa gsum gyi 'phags pa'i bar chad med lam rnams kyang rnam dag yin par rigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa las grol ba'i yon tan/ dbye na sangs rgyas sa'i 'gog lam gnyis so/ /byang sems kyi sgom lam zag med kyi mtshan nyid/ byang sems sgom lam gang zhig gzung 'dzin gnyis snang min pa/ 'di la mnyam bzhag gis ma khyab ste/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug bzhin no| |lam mgon rin chen mkhas mang legs bshad kyi/ /byi dor gyis sbyangs 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs pa/ /rnam par bshad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser bkod kyi// blo gsal rnams kyis legs bshad gang 'dod longs/

/skabs gnyis pa'i don bsdus pa legs par bshad zin to// // skabs gsum pa/ gzhi shes bshad pa/ （10na ）gsum pa gzhi shes kyi dngos po dgu la/ dang po shes pas srid la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ dus gsum de kho nar mnyam pa nyid du mngon gsum du shes pas tshu rol gyi mthar mi gnas pa'i slob lam/ chos gnyis pa snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje chen pos pha rol gyi mthar mi gnas pa'i byang 'phags kyi lam/ gnas mi gnas kyi don ni zhen ma zhen yin no/ /de gnyis la dbye na byang sems kyi sa bcu yod cing*/ sa mtshams kyang de nyid na yod do/ /chos gsum pa thabs min pas ring ba'i gzhi shes ky-i mtshan nyid/ ming dang dngos po'i mtshan mar dmigs pa'i sgo nas 'bras bu'i yum las ring ba'i 'phags lam| dbye na nyan rang 'phags pa'i lam drug sa mtshams kyang de nyid na yod do/ /chos bzhi pa thabs kyis ring ba min pa'i gzhi shes ky-i mtshan nyid| thabs shes khyad par can dang ldan pas 'bras yum las nye ba'i byang sems 'phags pa'i lam/ dbye na byang sems kyi sa bcu/ sa mtshams kyang de nyid na yod do/ /chos lnga pa mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum la mtshan mar bzung bas byang sems lam gyi spang byar gyur pa'i 'phags lam/ dbye na gsum las/ dang po gzhi la mtshan mar 'dzin pa ni/ gzugs sogs chos rnams gang zag gis bdag gis stong par bden par zhen pa dang*/ dus gsum gyi chos rnams la chos tsam du bden par zhen pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa lam la mtshan mar 'dzin pa ni/ byang phyogs so bdun la lam du bden par zhen pa'o/ /gsum pa brtson 'grus la mtshan mar 'dzin pa ni/ gzugs sku la skyabs gnas su bden par zhen pa'o/ / chos drug pa gnyen po gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pas mtshan 'dzin gyi sa bon spong bar nus pa'i byang sems kyi lam/

dbye na gzhi la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i gnyen po sogs gsum/ /sa mtshams byang sems kyi sa bcu nyid na yod/ chos bdun dngos bstan gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba'-i mtshan nyid/ gzugs sogs yul bcu la zhen pa bkag nas sgom pa gang zhig theg chen nges 'byed cha mthun gyi ngo bor gyur pa/ dbye na bcu las| dang po ni/ gzugs sogs gzhi'i ngo bo la mngon zhen bkag nas sgom pa'o| |gnyis pa ni/ rtag mi rtag sogs gzhi'i khyad par la mngon zhen bkag nas sgom pa'o/ /gzhi'i dbye ba la mngon zhen bkag nas sgom pa la （10ba ）mtshan nyid kyi dbye ba dang*/ spang gnyen gyi dbye ba la mngon zhen bkag pa gnyis las| dang po ni/ kun btags/ gzhan dbang*/ yongs grub gsum la mngon zhen bkag nas sgom pa ste sbyor ba gsum pa'o/ /de la kun btags kyi mtshan nyid| med bzhin du rtog pas sgro btags pa'i cha/ gzhan dbang gi mtshan nyid/ sgrib gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i rten 'brel/ yongs grub kyi mtshan nyid/ sgrib gnyis gang yang ma yin pa'i don dam/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs sogs la chags pa dang ma chags pa gnyis la blang dor du zhen pa bkag nas sgom pa ste sbyor ba bzhi pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ bstan ma bstan gyis 'phel 'grib tu mi 'gyur ba 'bras bu'i yum la mngon zhen bkag nas sgom pa'o/ /drug pa ni/ chos nyid la mngon zhen bkag nas sgom pa'o/ /bdun pa ni snang stong zung 'jug rtogs pa'i mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba la mngon zhen bkag nas sgom pa'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi nus pa la mngon zhen bkag nas sgom pa'o/ /dgu pa ni/ sbyor ba'i nus pa la mngon zhen bkag nas sgom pa'o/ /bcu pa ni/ chos thams cad rmi lam la sogs pa dang 'dra bar shes pa'i rjes thob kyi shes pa la mngon zhen bkag nas sgom pa'o/ /chos brgyad pa sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid ky-i mtshan nyid/

sbyor ba bcu po yul yuu can du bden par mi dmigs par sgom pa gang zhig theg chen nges 'byed cha mthun gyi ngo bor gyur pa/ dbye na/ gzugs sogs kyi dngos po la zhen pa bkag pa/ khyad par la zhen pa bkag pa| dbye ba la zhen pa bkag pa/ rtogs pa la zhen pa bkag pa ste bzhi'o/ /sbyor ba mnyam nyid gnyis ka sa mtshams theg chen sbyor lam nyid na yod/ chos dgu pa dngos bstan gzhi shes mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ zag med sgom lam ma skyes gong gi 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rtogs pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bgrod pa'i go skabs phye shul gang zhig gzhi shes sbyor ba'i 'bras bur gyur pa/ dbye na/ skad cig ma bcu drug ste/ sdug bden rtag mi rtag gi spros bral du rtogs pa sdug bsngal la chos bzod/ de bzhin du lam bden nges 'byin yin min gyi spros bral du rtogs pa lam la rjes shes kyi bar ro/ /sa mtshams dang po nyid na yod do/ /rang nyid gcig pu thar 'dod dman pa'i lam| |'gro kun phan bde sgrub byed lam gyi mchog /de dag ma 'dres gsal bar bstan zin gyis/ /kun kyang theg mchog lam la 'jug par mdzod/ /skabs gsum pa'i don bsdus pa legs par bshad zin to// // skabs bzhi pa/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba bshad pa/ （11na ）bzhi pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i chos bcu gcig las/ dang po rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi'am ye shes gyi khyad chos sbyor ba'i sgom byar gyur pa/ dbye na gnyis las/ dang po don rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ gzhi bdag gis stong pa'i cha/ gnyis pa shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ yul bdag med par mngon sum gyis rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis rang gi spang bya sna tshogs kyi gnyen po byed pa'i cha/ don rnam la dbye na gsum las/ gzhi shes kyi don rnam la med pa'i rnam pa la sogs pa bden pa dang po gsum gyi rnam pa bcu gnyis/ lam bden gyi rnam pa byed pa po med pa'i rnam pa la sogs pa nyan thos kyi lam bden gyi rnam pa bzhi/

rmi lam gyi rnam pa la sogs lnga dang*/ kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa drug ni/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam bden gyi rnam pa ste de ltar na nyer bdun no/ / gnyis pa lam shes kyi don rnam la/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rnam pa la sogs pa brgyad lam bden yin yang kun 'byung bden pa'i gnyen po yin pas kun bden gyi rnam par gzhag pa dang*/ tshad med pa'i rnam pa la sogs pa lam bden gyi rnam pa bdun dang*/ mi rtag pa'i rnam pa la sogs pa sdug bden gyi lnga dang*/ nang stong pa nyid nas dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa'i bar bcu drug ste mdor na so drug go / gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi don rnam la gsum ste/ gzhi shes dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam pa/ lam shes dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam pa/ thun mong ma yin pa rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'o/ /dang po la byang phyogs so bdun las/ dran pa nyer bzhag gi mtshan nyid/ lus tshor sems chos bzhi gang zag gam chos kyi bdag med par rtogs pa'i dran pa'am shes rab/ dbye na lus dran pa nyer bzhag sogs bzhi/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam chung ngu nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod do/ /theg dman gyi tshogs lam ril po nas dgra bcom gyi bar du yod do/ /yang dag spong ba'i mtshan nyid/ dge sdig la blang dor phyin ci ma log par byed pa'i brtson 'grus/ dbye na mi dge ba skyes pa yang dag par spong ba'i rgyu'i brtson 'grus sogs bzhi'o/ /sa mtshamasas theg chen gyi tshogs lam 'bring nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod do/ /theg dman gyi sbyor lam drod nas dgra bcom gyi bar du yod/ rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i mtshan nyid/ bdag rkyen spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad bsten pa las byung ba'i sems las su rung ba| dbye na 'dun pa'i ting nge 'dzin sogs bzhi/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam chen po nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/

theg dman gyi sbyor lam rtse mo nas dgra bcom gyi bar du yod/ dbang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang 'bras 'phags lam skyed pa la dbang byed pa'i rtogs pa/ dbye na dad pa'i dbang po sogs lnga/ sa mtshams theg chen sbyor lam drod nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar du yod cing*/ theg dman gyi sbyor lam bzod pa nas dgra bcom gyi bar du yod do/ /stobs kyi mtshan nyid/ dbang po nyid mi mthun phyogs zil gyis gnon pa'i nus pa mthu can du gyur pa/ dbye na dad pa'i stobs sogs lnga| sa mtshams theg chen gyi sbyor lam bzod pa nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod/ theg dman gyi sbyor lam chos mchog nas dgra bcom gyi bar du yod do/ /theg chen gyi byang chub yan lag gi mtshan nyid/ chos dbyings mngon sum gyis rtogs pa'i rang bzhin dang gnas pa la sogs pa'i （11ba ）sgo nas yan lag gyur pa/ dbye na dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag la sogs pa bdun no/ /sa mtshams theg chen gyi mthong lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs gyi byang chub yan lag gi mtshan nyid/ rang 'bras zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur gyur gang zhig mthong lam las nus pa che ba zhes 'dod par sems so/ / 'phags lam yan lag gi mtshan nyid/ yongs su gcod pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i yan lag tu gyur pa/ dbye na yang dag pa'i lta ba 'phags pa'i lam yan lag la sogs pa brgyad/ sa mtshams mthong lam rjes thob nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod do/ /gnyis pa lam shes dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam pa la sum cu rtsa bzhi las/ rnam thar sgo gsum gyi mtshan nyid| mi rtag la sogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ sa mtshams lam thams cad na yod do/ /gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar gyi mtshan nyid/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas rang gi lus la gzugs kyi snang ba dang bcas pa'i sgo nas phyi rol snod bcud kyi gzugs rnams la sna tshogs su bltas pas sprul pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba'i rnam grol gyi lam/

sdug pa'i rnam thar gyi mtshan nyid/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas ro gcig pa'i 'du shes sgom pa'i gzugs thams cad sdug par sprul pa'i sgrib pa las grol ba'i rnam grol gyi lam/ nam mkha' mtha' yas kyi rnam thar gyi mtshan nyid/ nam mkha' mtha' yas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam grol gyi lam rnam par dag pa/ thog ma gsum des 'gre'o/ 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa'i rnam thar gyi mtshan nyid/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug gang zhig snyoms 'jug la ro myang gi sgrib pa las grol ba'i cha/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ dgag gzhi rig tsam gyi steng du dgag bya yid kyi rnam shes dang nyon yid 'khor dang bcas pa bkag pa'i snyoms 'jug nyan thos kyi lugs kyis mtshan nyid 'di mi 'dod kyang nyan thos gyi rgyud la yod pa'i 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug ni mtshan nyid 'di dang ldan pa kho na'o/ /'di gnas gyur ma thob gong du ting nge 'dzin ma yin la thob nas ting nge 'dzin yin no/ /'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug ting nge 'dzin yin par ston pa dang*/ ma yin par ston pa'i lung rnams kyang de gnyis la dgongs so/ /sa mtshams rnam thar dang po bdun theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod nas thob/ brgyad pa sa dang po nas thob/ nyan thos kyi phyir mi 'ong lus mngon byed dang*/ dgra bcom gnyis ka'i cha las rnam grol la brgyad ka yod/ phyir mi 'ong dang dgra bcom gzhan la dang po bdun yod pa srid/ rgyun zhugs dang*/ phyir 'ong la brgyad ka mi srid/ bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal dgra bcom la brgyad ka yod/ rang rgyal dgra bcom gzhan ci rigs su yod/ gnyis ka'i cha las rnam grol theg chen lam du zhugs pa'i theg chen tshogs lam pa la brgyad ka yod do/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam ni zhib par snyoms 'jug gsal rgyan du lta'o/ /spong ba'i lam gyi mtshan nyid/ rang gi spang bya mthong spang gyi sa bon dngos su 'joms pa'i chos bzod/（12na ）dbye na sdug bsngal chos bzod sogs bzhi/

a bha ya'i lugs so/ /phar phyin drug bshad zin to| |thabs mkhas phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ /mi rtog ye shes kyis zin pa'i thabs mkhas/ smon lam phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ mi rtog ye shes gyis zin pa'i smon lam/ stobs kyi phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ mi rtog ye shes kyis zin pa'i gzhan don rlabs chen sgrub pa'i nus pa/ ye shes kyi phar phyin gyi mtshan nyid/ mi rtog ye shes kyis zin pa'i thos bsam gyi shes rab bo/ /gsum pa thun mong min pa rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa la sum cu rtsa dgu las/ dang po stobs kyi mtshan nyid| las rgyu 'bras dang theg pa gsum gyi gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par mkhyen nas de dag la phyin ci log tu 'dzin pa'i bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i ye shes mthar thug dbye na bcu las/ dang po ni/ dge ba la 'bras bu yid du 'ong ba 'byung mi dge ba las 'bras bu yid du mi 'ong bar rtogs nas ston pa'i ye shes mthar thug go /de bzhin du gnyis pa ni/ dge ba las dge ba spyod pa po rang nyid la 'bras bu 'ong ba 'byung mi dge ba las mi dge ba spyod pa po nyid la 'bras bu yid du mi 'ong ba 'byung bar rtogs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ gdul bya yod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad mkhyen pa'o/ /byang sar theg pa gsum gyi rigs thams cad ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen pa la bshad/ lnga pa ni| sems can thams cad kyi dbang po rno rtul mkhyen pa'o/ /drug pa ni/ bde 'gro ngan 'gro byang chub gsum gyi lam thams cad ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen pa'o| |bdun pa ni/ nyon mongs can gyi bsam gtan gzugs med dang*/ nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i bsam gtan gzugs med ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen pa gzhan la bstan nas nyon mongs can gyi bsam gtan gzugs med la thar par rlom pa sel ba'o/ /nyon mongs can yin min yang snyoms 'jug gsal rgyan du blta'o|

|brgyad pa dgu pa bcu pa gsum rim pa ltar sangs rgyas kyi sa'i sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang*/ lha'i mig dang*/ zag pa zad par shes pa'o| |stobs kyi gzhom bya bdud bzhi ni/ thabs dang*/ skyabs dang*/ dag pa dang*/ theg chen gyi nges 'byung la slu ba'i bdud do/ /dang po ni/ 'bras bu bde sdug la rgyu dge sdig sngon du song ba med par 'dzin pa ste/ 'di ni stobs dang pos 'joms so/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyir dge sdig las bde sdug 'byung yang*/ dbang phyug la sogs pas gzhan gyi dge sdig gi 'bras bu bde sdug gzhan la bsgyur du yod par 'dzin pa ste/ 'di ni stobs gnyis pas 'joms so/ /gsum pa ni/ 'jig rten pa'i bsam btan gzugs med kyi sems thob pa la thar pa thob par 'dzin pa ste/ 'di ni stobs bdun pas 'joms so/ /bzhi pa ni| theg pa chen po'i rigs can theg dman du ltung ba ste/ 'di ni stobs lhag ma bdun gyis 'joms so/ /mi 'jigs pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang nyid don gnyis mthar （12ba ）phyin par mkhyen nas gzhan la bag mi tsha ba'i ye shes/ dbye na bzhi'o/ /so so yang dag par rig pa'i mtshan nyid/ bshad bya dang 'chad byed thams cad thogs pa med par mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ dbye na bzhi'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i mtshan nyid/ de pa'i sku dang gsung dang thugs dang 'phrin las kyi yon tan gang zhig nyan rang dang thun mong ma yin pa/ dbye na bco brgyad do/ /stobs bcu nas 'di'i bar rjes mthun pa byang 'phags la'ang yod cing*/ so rig bzhi nyan thos la'ang yod par bshad do/ /de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa ni ngo bo nyid kyi sku rang byung gi rnam pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam pa ni rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes snga ma ni srid pa tha ma pa'i tshe slob dpon gzhan la ma ltos par shes bya thams cad la dbang bsgyur nus pa'i cha nas bzhag la/ phyi ma ni chos thams cad mkhyen pa'i cha nas bzhag go /mdor na rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa brgya dang bcu'o/

/brgya dang bcu po thams cad lam bden gyi rnam par bshad pa ni phal che ba'i dbang du byas pa ste/ de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa 'gog bden yin pas so/ /don rnam gyi sa mtshams shes bya thams cad la yod/ shes rnam ni don rnam brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum po mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum ste sa mtshams 'phags pa bzhi'i rgyud kho na la yod do/ /chos gnyis pa la zhar byung sbyor ba po gang zag gi mtshan nyid/ sngon tshogs bsags pas yum nyan pa la sogs pa'i snod du rung ba'i gang zag dbye na sbyor ba'i gzhung nyan pa dang*/ gzhung gi tshig blo la len pa dang*/ don mi brjed par 'dzin pa dang*/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i snod bzhi'o/ /sa mtshams dang po gnyis lam la ma zhugs pa la'ang cung zad yod par mngon zhing*/ phal cher tshogs lam chung ngu nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod do/ / sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ mkhyen pa gsum gyi rnam pa rnams bsdus te sgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga dang*/ gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga ste nyi shu'o/ /rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga la/ dang po gnas pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ yul gzugs sogs la zhen pa bkag nas sgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ sbyor ba bkag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ yul sbyor ba la zhen pa bkag nas sgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ zab pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi'i chos nyid zab par rtogs nas sgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ gting dpag dka' ba'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ lam gyi chos nyid gting dpag dka' bar rtogs nas sgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ tshad med pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam pa'i chos nyid tshad med par rtogs nas sgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'di lnga ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad par theg chen tshogs lam chung ngu nas rgyun mtha'i bar thams cad na yod do/ /gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga la/ tshegs chen yun ring rtogs pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/

chos dbyings la dngangs skrag skye srid pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'di theg chen tshogs lam nyid na yod do/ /lung bstan pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ chos dbyings la dngangs skrag med par bsgoms pas byang chub tu lung bstan pa dang nye bar gyur pa'i drod kyi rnal 'byor/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ gnas skabs thams cad du sbyor ba dang mi 'bral ba'i rtse mo'i rnal 'byor/ nges par 'byung ba'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ 'khor ba dang （13na ）sa gnyis yid la byed pas mi brdzi ba'i bzod pa'i rnal 'byor/ bar chad med pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ sbyor ba rgyun ldan du sgom pas mthong lam dang nye bar shes pa'i chos mchog gi rnal 'byor/ byang chub nye ba'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ zag med kyi chos gsar du thob pa'i sa dang po'i rnal 'byor/ byang chub myur ba'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ myur du sku gsum 'grub par byed pa'i sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar gyi rnal 'byor/ de dag gis sa mtshams mtshan nyid kyi tshig zur las shes so/ /gzhan don gyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/

chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar nus pa'i dag pa sa'i rnam 'byor/ 'phel 'grib med pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ chos thams cad don dam par 'phel 'grib med par rtogs nas sgom pa'i dag pa sa'i rnala'abyor/ chos dang chos min sogs mi mthong gi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ dge sdig la sogs pa'i chos thams cad bden par ma dmigs par rtogs nas sgom pa'i dag pa sa'i rnal 'byor/ gzugs sogs bsam mi khyab mi mthong gi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ /gzugs sogs kyi chos dbyings la cir yang mi rlom pa'i dag pa sa'i rnal 'byor/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ gzugs sogs chos thams cad kyi mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum la ma zhen par sgom pa'i dag pa sa'i rnal 'byor/ de lnga sa brgyad pa nas thob bo/ /'bras bu rin chen sbyin byed kyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid| mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul bstan nas gdul bya dpag tu med pa skal ba dang mtshams par theg pa gsum gyi 'bras bu la 'god par nus pa'i dag pa sa'i sgrub pa/ 'di sa dgu pa nas thob/ rnam par dag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid| sgrib gnyis kyi bag chags dag par byed pa'i sgrub pa mthar thug 'di rgyun mthar thob/ sa mtshams kyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ bdud las kyis mi tshugs pa don du dus tshigs kyi yi dam blangs nas sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'di tshogs lam chung ngu nas sa bdun pa man chad na yod do/ /chos gsum pa sbyor ba'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid/ sbyor ba las thob par bya ba'i phan yon/ dbye na gnyis las/ sbyor ba'i gnas skabs kyi yon tan gyi mtshan nyid/ sbyor ba las gnas skabs su thob pa'i phan yon/ 'di tshogs lam chung ngu nas rgyun mtha'i bar thams cad na yod do/ /sbyor ba'i mthar thug gi yon tan gy-i mtshan nyid| sbyor ba las mthar thug tu thob pa'i phan yon/ 'di sangs rgyas kyi sar yod/ gzhung nas bshad pa'i bcu bzhi po rnams ni 'ga' zhig gnas skabs kyi yin la 'ga' zhig mthar thug gi yin no/

/ chos bzhi pa sbyor ba'i skyon gy-i mtshan nyid/ sbyor ba la bar du gcod pa'i bdud las/ dbye na 'dir zhe drug gsungs la/ theg chen gyi mdo gzhan las bdud las gsungs pa rnams kyang shes nas spang bar bya ba nyid yin no| |sa mtshams gtso cher tshogs sbyor na yod cing*/ sa bdun pa man chad na'ang phra ba yod de rang don gyi zhen 'khris yod pas so/ /sa brgyad pa yan chad na med de ngar 'dzin gnas 'gyur bas so/ / chos lnga ba sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid gyi mtshan nyid/ sbyor ba'i nus pa'am rang bzhin mtshon byed/ dbye na gnyis las dang po byed sgrub ky-i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu sbyor ba la rang skyed pa'i nus pa yod par mtshon byed/ dbye na gsum las| dang po shes pa'i mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid/ gzhi lam rnam gsum bden pa'i rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i blo gang zhig rang rgyu mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba la rang skyed pa'i nus pa yod par mtshon byed/ dbye na gsum las/ dang po gzhi shes kyi shes mtshan gy-i mtshan nyid/ gzhi bden pa'i rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i blo gang zhig rang rgyud gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba la rang skyed pa'i nus pa yod par mtshon byed/ gnyis pa lam shes kyi shes mtshan dang*/ gsum pa rnam mkhyen shes mtshan yang des 'dre zhing*/ de gsum re re la dbye na bcu drug bcu drug tu yod cing*/ sa mtshams gtso bor sangs rgyas kyi sa na yod la/ phal pa'i tshul gyis tshogs lam 'bring yan chad thams cad na yod do/ /khyad mtshan dang*/ shes mtshan yang de dang 'dra'o/ / gnyis pa khyad mtshan gyi mtshan nyid/ theg dman las khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos gang zhig rang rgyu lam shes rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba la rang skyed pa'i nus pa （13ba ）yod par mtshon byed/ dbye na bcu drug go /gsum pa byed mtshan gyi mtshan nyid/ gzhan don sgrub pa'i nus pa gang zhig rang rgyu mkhyen gsum gyi sbyor ba la rang skyed pa'i nus pa yod par mtshon byed/

dbye na bcu'o| |gnyis pa las sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ sbyor ba'i rang bzhin mtshon byed gang zhig sbyor ba'i spangs rtogs dang sems bskyed kyi yon tan gang rung yin pa dbye na bcu drug sa mtshams theg chen tshogs lam chung ngu nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na mkhyen pa'i ngo bo tsam yod kyi 'di'i skabs kyi las sgrub mtshan nyid pa med do/ / chos drug pa la/ spyir thar pa cha mthun gy-i mtshan nyid/ myang 'das la phan 'dogs byed kyi dge rtsa dge nges 'byed cha mthun ma skyes gong gis bsdus pa| nyan thos kyi thar pa cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ nyan thos kyi myang 'das la phan 'dogs byed gang zhig nyan thos kyi nges 'byed cha mthun ma skyes gong gi dge rtsa yin pa/ rang rgyal gyi thar pa cha mthun yang des 'dre zhing*/ skabs su bab par theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub la phan 'dogs byed kyi dge ba gang zhig dbang po'i rim ma gyur pa/ dbye na/ dad pa| brtson 'grus/ dran pa/ ting nge 'dzin/ shes rab kyi bdag nyid kyi thar pa cha mthun lnga'o/ /de nyid gsum du 'gyur te/ gnas skabs theg chen du rigs nges pa'i byang sems las dang po pa'i dad sogs thar pa cha mthun chen po dang*/ gnas skabs theg dman du rigs nges pa'i byang sems las dang po pa'i dad sogs thar pa cha mthun chung du dang*/ gnas skabs gang du'ang rigs ma nges pa'i byang sems las dang po pa'i dad sogs thar pa cha mthun 'bring ste de dag go /mdo dang 'phags pa grol sde'i dgongs pa'o/ /slob dpon ltar na thar cha la dbye na/ las dang po pa'i dad sogs lnga/ de nyid gnyis su 'gyur te theg pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par rdzaugs pa'i byang chub thob nus pa'i dad sogs/ thar cha chen po dang*/ theg pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob mi nus pa'i thar cha chung ngu'o/ /zhes dngos su bstan pas shugs la thar cha chung du de nyid la gnyis las/

thar cha 'bring po rang rgyal gyi dad sogs kyis rang rgyal gyi byang chub thob nus la/ chung ngu nyan thos kyi dad sogs kyis nyan thos kyi byang chub thob nus so zhes bstan par bzhed do/ /yang na/ thar cha la dbye na tshogs lam chung 'bring che gsum mo/ /sa mtshams kyang de nyid na yod do/ /chos bdun pa la/ spyir nges 'byed cha mthun gy-i mtshan nyid/ rang 'bras mthong lam la phan byed kyi 'jig rten pa'i dge ba gang zhig thar cha mthun rdzogs pa'i rjes la byung ba/ nyan thos kyi nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid| nyan thos kyi mthong lam la phan byed kyi dge ba gang zhiganyan thos kyi thar pa cha mthun rdzogs pa'i rjes la byung ba/ dbye na drod rtse bzod pa gsum la chung 'bring chen po gsum gsum/ chos mchog la skad cig ma gcig go /rang rgyal nges 'byed cha mthun des 'dre zhing*/ skabs su babs pa 'dir smos theg chen nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen tshogs lam la phan byed kyi dge ba theg chen gyi tshogs lam rdzogs pa'i rjes kyi dge ba gang zhig sems can la dmigs pa'i rnam pa khyad par can dang ldan pa/ dbye na/ drod chung 'bring che gsum gyi rjes thob kyis bsdus pa mnyam pa dang byams pa'i sems la sogs pa bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa bcu dang*/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog rnams re re la chung 'bring chen po gsum gsum yod pa'i rje thob rnams kyis rim pa ltar bsdus pa bdag gis dge bcu la gnas nas gzhan yang dge ba bcu la 'god/ bsngags mthun pas dga' bar byed pa sogs sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa dgu ste bsam sbyor phun sum tshogs pa bcu dgu'o/ /chos brgyad la slob pa phyir mi ldog pa dge 'dun gyi mtshan nyid/ theg dman du mi ltung bar nges pa'i rtags dang ldan pa'i byang sems/ dbye na/ sbyor lam pa/ mthong lam pa/ sgom lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun gsum mo/ /（14na ）de gsum gyi mtshan nyid/

rim pa ltar nges 'byed cha mthun la gnas pa'i sems dpa' gang zhig rang nyid theg dman du mi ltung bar nges pa'i rtags nyi shu po gang rung dang ldan pa dang*/ sa dang po la gnas pa'i byang sems gang zhig rang nyid gnas skabs theg dman du mi ltung ba'i rtags gzugs sogs 'du shes ldaug pa sogs rnam pa bcu drug po gang rung dang ldan pa dang*/ sgom lam la gnas pa'i sems dpa' gang zhig zab mo brgyad rtogs pa'i mnyam bzhag dang rjes su mthun pa'i lus ngag gi tha snyad khyad par can dang ldan pa'o/ /sa mtshams byang chub sems dpa' dbang po rno na drod nas phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob/ dbang po 'bring gis sa dang po nas thob/ shin tu rtul yang sa brgyad lam nas thob bo| |tshogs lam na'ang gnas skabs rdzaugs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa yod kyang phyir mi ldog par nges byed kyi rtags rang gzhan la mthun snang du grub pa med pas phyir mi ldog gi dge 'dun ni ma bzhag ces mkhas pa dag gsung*| 'grig nas sbyor lam gyis skabs su rgyu tshogs grangs tshang rtags su bkod nas 'bras bu 'byung rung dpog pa'i rtags su bshad/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig theg chen sbyor lam thob pa la phyir mi ldog gi rtags thob pas khyab par bzhed par snang ngo*/ /chos dgu pa srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam kun khyad par can gang zhig 'khor 'das bden pa'i rang bzhin med par mtshungs par sgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ dngos dang klan ka spang ba gnyis kyis ston/ sa mtshams rnam kun khyad par can dang mtshungs par phyir mi ldog gi rtags thob pa nas yod par bzhed do/ / chos bcu pa zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rnam kun khyad par can gang zhig snod bcud kyi 'jig rten nyes pa med cing yon tan dang ldan pa'i rgyur sgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na/ snod dag pa dang*/ bcud dag pa'i sbyor ba gnyis| sa mtshams snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /chos bcu gcig pa thabs la mkhas pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/

rnam kun khyad par can gang zhig yul bcu la dus dang dus ma yin pa shes pas 'phrin las phun tshogs kyi rgyud sgom pa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na bcu'o/ /sa mtshams dag pa sa gsum na yod/ gzhan don byed pa'i dus dang dus min pa shes pa'i sbyor ba de kho na yod pa'i phyir ro/ /tshig gsal las sa bcu pa nyid nas yod par bzhed do/ /mkhas rlom brgya yis sngon chad ma rnya ེda pa'i/ /mdo dang 'grel pa'i snying po bsdus pa 'di/ /bla ma'i drin thob kho bos ma phye na/ /stong gsum gser gyis bkang yang grub par dka'/ /skabs bzhi pa'i don ni bsdus pa legs par bshad zin to// // skabs lnga pa/ rtse sbyor bshad pa/ rtse sbyor gyi chos brgyad la/ dang po drod kyi rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ rtags bcu gnyis kyis bsdus sgom rab tu gyur par mtshon pa'i drod/ dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas chung 'bring che gsum/ mtshon byed rtags kyi sgo nas bcu gnyis/ sa mtshams byang sems sbyor lam drod nyid na yod/ chos gnyis pa rtse mo'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ rnam 'phel bcu drug gis dngos su mtshon pa'i mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom rab gyur gang zhig rang 'bras bzod pa chung ngu'i nyer len/ dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas chung 'bring che gsum| mtshon byed kyi sgo nas bsod nams rnam par 'phel ba'i yon tan bcu drug sa mtshams theg chen sbyor lam rtse mo nyid na yod/ chos gsum pa bzod pa'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ sems brtan pa'i yon tan gnyis kyi mtshon pa'i mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom rab gyur gang zhig rang 'bras chos mchog chung ngu'i nyer len/ dbye na ngo bo'i sgo nas chung 'bring che gsum| mtshon byed kyi sgo nas mkhyen pa gsum gyi rtogs pa'i rigs rang rgyud la rdzogs par byed pa'i bsngo ba brtan pa dang gzhan don byed pa'i bsam sbyor brtan pa gnyis so/ /sa mtshams theg chen sbyor lam bzod pa nyid na yod/

chos bzhi pa chos mchog rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ sems dpa' bzhi'i dge ba la yid rang dang mtshungs ldan gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i chos mchog bsod nams mang po dang ldan pa/ dbye na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas chung 'bring che gsum/ mtshon byed ting nge 'dzin gyi 'bras bu tshogs gnyis/ sa mtshams theg chen sbyor lam chos mchog nyid na yod/ chos lnga pa mthong lam rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ kun btags su gyur pa'i gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa'i gnyen po byang chub chen po'i rgyu tshogs tshang ba gang zhig（14ba ）pha rol tu phyin pa re re'i nang dudrug drug tshang ba'i rnam pa can gyi mnyam bzhag dang rnam thar snyoms 'jug sgom zhing kun byang gi rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs ldog la rtog pa'i rjes thob ky-is bsdus pa/ de la 'dir smos 'jug pa gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi lam 'bras la don dam par 'jug yul du 'khrul ba'i blo/ dbye na/ yul gyi dbang gis dgu sa mtshams theg chen tshogs sbyor rjes thob na mngon gyur yod/ sa bon mnyam bzhag dus na'ang yod/ 'dir smos ldog pa gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid/ nyan rang gi lam 'bras la don dam par dor byar 'khrul ba'i blo/ dbye ba sa mtshams snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /'dir smos rdzas 'dzin 'dzin rtog gi mtshan nyid/ so so skye bo'i 'dzin pa la don dam par rdzas 'dzin du 'khrul ba'i blo/ dbye na yul rdzas 'dzin dgu'i dbye bas rtog pa dgu'o/ /sa mtshams yul rdzas 'dzin so so skye bo thams cad la mngon gyur yod la/ sa bon tsam nyan rang 'phags pa slob pa dang sa bdun pa man chad na'ang yod do/ /rdzas 'dzin 'dzin rtog gi ni theg chen gyi tshogs sbyor rdzogs na'ang yod do/ /'dir rtog pa'i yul gyi yul dgu ni theg chen gyi lam 'bras bstan par kha cig bzhed/ slob dpon ltar na de'i nges pa maid do/ /'dir smos btags 'dzin 'dzin rtog gi mtshan nyid/

'phags pa'i btags 'dzin la don dam par btags 'dzin du 'khrul ba'i blo/ dbye na dguu sa mtshams yul btags 'dzin ni nyan rang 'phags pa la yod par dag ldan las bshad/ sa bcu'i rjes thob na'ang yod par mngon no/ /btags 'dzin rtog pa ni theg chen tshogs sbyor rjes thob na yod do/ /mdo las gzung rtog gnyis kyi skabs su gnyen po dngos su bstan/ 'dzin rtog gnyis kyi skabs su rtog pa'i yul gyi yul dngos su bstan to/ /byang chub chen po la spyir gnas skabs kyi dang mthar thug gi byang chub chen po gnyis/ gnas skabs kyi byang chub chen po sa dang po nas yod/ mthar thug gi byang chub chen po sangs rgyas kyi sa kho na na yod/ byang chub tsam zhig nyan rang dgra bcom la'ang yod/ 'dir ni gtso bo mthar thug gi byang chub chen po nyid yin la/ de'i mtshan nyid/ sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma gdod ma nas zad pa dang gdod ma nas mi skye ba mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug dbye na sku bzhi yod par tshig gsal du bshad kyang dngos su ni rtogs pa ye shes chos kyi sku nyid yin no/ /theg chen mthong lam ni de'i gnyen po yin la lhan gcig byed pa'i rkyen gsum ni mthong lam pas rang gi gdul bya mthong lam gyi rtogs pa la bkod pa'i sgo nas byang chub tu lung bstan thob pa la 'god pa dang*/ sher phyin gyi gzhung gi tshogs chud mi za bar 'dzin pa'i shes rab la 'god pa dang*/ rang sher phyin sgom zhing gzhan theg chen gyi rigs can la sher phyin ston pa'o/ /mtshan nyid kyi zur gyi dri ma gdod ma nas zad pa dang mi skye ba'i don ni/ dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la dri ma dang po nas gzhi ma grub pas zad pa yang med skye ba yang med pa'o/ /dngos por smra ba dag kun 'byung sngar gnyen pos bcom pa zad pa'i don dang sdug bsngal skye 'gyur rgyu zad nas mi skye bar byas pa mi skye ba'i don du 'dod cing de 'dra'i zad pa dang mi skye ba bden par 'dod de shes pa'i ye shes byang chub yin par 'dod do/

/de mi 'thad de/ gcig dang du bral la sogs pa'i rtags kyis dri ma mi bden par grub la dri ma mi bden na dri ma zad pa dang mi skye ba yang mi bden pa'i phyir| 'dir snod gyi sa gzhi la grub mtha'i sgo nas bzhag na/ bdag med la dmigs pa rnal 'byor gyi sa'i mtshan nyid/ nyan thos kyi mngon par rtogs pa| dbye na/ bye brag tu smra ba'i dang mdo sde pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis yod/ bye brag tu smra ba ni bstan bcos bye brag tu bshad pa'i rjes su 'brang zhing*/ dus gsum rdzas su yod par 'dod pa'o/ /mdo sde pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo sde tshad mar 'dzin cing 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dngos por med da ltar ba'i bem po dang rig pa thams cad dngos por yod par 'dod pa'o/ /sems tsam la dmigs pa rnal 'byor gyi sa'i mtshan nyid/ sems tsam rnam bden pa'i mngon par rtogs pa/ de bzhin nyid la dmigs pa rnal 'byor gyi sa'i mtshan nyid| sems tsam rnam rdzun pa'i mngon par rtogs pa/ de gnyis la dbye na/ tshogs lam dang sbyor lam gnyis gnyis gnyis par kun la grags pa thob nas mnyam bzhag tu dbu ma pa'i lta ba rtogs kyang rjes thob na sngon gyi bag chags kyi dbang gis sems tsam grub mtha' bden zhen gyis khas len pa yod par zin bris las bshad/ rnam bden rdzun gyi khyad par ni don gyi rnam pa shes par bden par 'dod pa dang sgro btags par 'dod pa'o/ /snang ba med pa la dmigs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa'i mtshan nyid/ dbu ma pa'i mngon par rtogs pa| dbye na/ dbu ma pa'i lam lnga/ dbu ma pa la dbye na/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dang*/ mdo sde spyod pa dang*/ 'jig rten grags sde spyod pa'i dbu ma pa'o| |de bzhin rim pa ltar don dam par chos thams cad mtha' bral nam mkha' ltar 'dod par mtshungs la/ kun rdzob tha snyad byed tshul sems tsam pa dang*/ mdo sde pa dang*/ lo ka phal pa dang mthun par khas len pa'o/ /dang po ni slob dpon seng bzang la sogs pa'o/

/ gnyis pa ni bha bya kirti la sogs pa'o| |gsum pa ni/ slob dpon zla grags la sogs pa'o/ /de rnams kyi snga ma gnyis la rang rgyud pa dang phyi ma gnyis la thal 'gyur ba zer ro/ /de dag thams cad kyi skabs de bzhin/ gang gis bdag med pa mthong na nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa las grol/ chos kyi bdag med pa mthong na shes bya'i sgrib pa las grol zhes （15na）snying po mchog las bshad pa ltar ro/ /mthong lam rtse mo'i skabs su snying po mchog las/ skad cig ma gcig yin gyi skad cig ma bcu drug ni ma yin no| |de yang bzod pas bsdus pa yin gyi bzod pa brgyad shes pa brgyad ni ma yin te/ de ni mthong ba'i lam mo zhes 'byung ba dang*/ slob dpon seng bzang mthong lam skad cig gcig yin par bzhed pa gnyis mthun par mngon no| |mthong lam rtse mo'i rigs mi mthun sel ba'i mtshan nyid/ sbyor lam chos mchog rdzogs pa'i rjes nas theg chen sgom lam ma skyes gong gi dge ba gang zhig mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom rab gyur/ dbye na skad cig bcu drug yod dgos mchi| sa mtshams sa dang po nyid na yod do/ / chos drug pa sgom lam rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen mthong lam rdzogs kyi rjes nas sangs rgyas ma thob bar gyi dge ba gang zhig mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa/ 'dir thod rgal gyi snyoms 'jug gi sgo nas bstan na| de la sbyor ba seng ge rnam sgyings dang dngos gzhi thod rgal gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ theg chen sgom lam pa'i snyoms 'jug gang zhig thod rgal gyi sbyor bas bsdus pa/ dbye na snyoms 'jug dgu la lugs mthun lugs mi mthun du snyoms par 'jug pa gnyis/ dngos gzhi thod rgal la dbye na/ dngos gzhi tsam po ba/ dngos gzhi khyad par can/ dngos gzhi ches khyad par can gsum mo/ / mtshan nyid ni rim pa ltar/ byang sems sgom lam thod rgal gyi snyoms 'jug gang zhig bsam gtan dang po nas 'gog pa'i bar du sems gzhan gyis bar ma chod par snyoms par 'jug pa dang*/

de dag gi mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu la 'gog pa'i bar du spel nas lugs mthun du snyoms par 'jug pa dang*/ gang zhig snyoms 'jug dgu la 'dod sems spel nas lugs mi mthun du snyoms par 'jug pa'o/ /thod rgal khyad par can sa brgyad pa kun yan yod par dkon mchog sprin las bshad do/ /sgom lam rtse mo'i spang bya rtog pa la bzhi las/ sgom spang 'jug pa gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi lam 'bras la dmigs nas sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul gyis 'jug byar rtog pa'i blo/ dbye na dgu/ sa mtshams sa bcu pa'i rjes thob kyi ngo bor yod do/ /sgom spang ldog pa gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid/ nyan rang gi lam 'bras la dmigs nas sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul gyis dor bya 'khrul ba'i blo/ dbye ba sa mtshams snga ma bzhin no/ /sgom spang rdzas 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ so skye'i 'dzin pa la dmigs nas tha snyad tsam du rdzas 'dzin du 'khrul ba'i blo/ sgom spang rtags 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi btags 'dzin la dmigs nas tha snyad tsam du btags 'dzin du 'khrul ba'i blo/ 'di gnyis kyi dbye ba sa mtshams kyang gong bzhin no/ /ming 'dogs 'di dag slob dpon gyi yin gyi 'phags pa dang mi mthun no/ /de dag gis thod brgal snyoms 'jug gi ngor gyur zhing*/ gnyis snang gi rtog pa'i gnyen por gyur la/ yon tan phun sum tshogs pa rten du gyur pa ni sgom lam rtse mo yin zhes bstan to/ / chos bdun pa bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom gang zhig rang 'bras rnam mkhyen gyi de ma thag rkyen du gyur pa/ sa mtshams rgyun mtha' nyid na yod/ de'i dmigs rkyen ni bden dngos kyis stong pa'i sgyu ma lta bu/ bdag rkyen ni yang dag pa'i don ma brjed pa'i dran pa/ rnam pa ni rang bzhin gyis zhi ba/ de la gnyis las/ blo'i rnam pa ni spros pa sngar yod zhi ba min par gdod ma nas spros pa nye bar zhi ba'i chos nyid do/

/de rtogs pa blo'i rnam pa'o/ /'dir rgyu rkyen gyi mtshan nyid la/ nyer len rgyu'i mtshan nyid/ rkyen rnams la ltos nas 'bras bu'i ngo bo skyed byed/ lhan cig byed rkyen gyi mtshan nyid/ nyer len rgyus 'bras bu skyed pa'i grogs su gyur pa/ de la gsum las/ dmigs rkyen gyi mtshan nyid/ byed rgyu'i yan lag gang zhig shes pa yul gyi rnam ldan du skyed byed/ bdag rkyen gy-i mtshan nyid/（15ba ）byed rgyu'i yan lag gang zhig 'bras bu rang dbang du skyed byed/ de ma thag rkyen gy-i mtshan nyid/ rig pa gang zhig rang dang rgyud gcig gis bsdus pa'i rig pa phyi ma dngos su skyed byed/ rkyen phyi ma gnyis dang nyon mongs mi 'gal lo/ / chos brgyad pa bsal bya log sgrub gyi mtshan nyid/ rnam mkhyen gyi chos skor la dmigs nas snang stong 'gal bar 'dzin pa'i log rtog slob dpon ltar na bar chad med rtse'i zer/ dbye na gdul bya nye ba'i bsam pa la ltos nas bcu drug sa mtshams mngon gyur phyi nang gi dngos por smra ba rnams la yod cing*/ lhan skyes sa bdun pa man chad kyi gang zag thams cad yod de stong pa nyid la rtsod pa dang zhes so/ /log rtog de dag gis kun nas slang ba'i thal 'gyur la gnyis las/ don dam pa sgo can gyi klan ka ni/ don dam pa rtags su bkod nas kun rdzob sun 'byin pa'i thal 'gyur ltar snang ste/ dper na/ shes bya chos can| rnam mkhyen gyi dmigs par mi 'thad par la/ chos thams cad dngos por med pa'i phyir zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de la kun rdzob tu rtags ma grub ces kun rdzob kyi sgo nas lan 'debs so/ /kun rdzob sgo can gyi klan ka ni kun rdzob rtags su bkod nas don dam pa sun 'byin pa'i thal 'gyur ltar snang ste dper na| shes bya chos can/ chos rnams yod par thal/ rnam mkhyen gyi dmigs pa yod pa'i phyir zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de la don dam du rtags ma grub ces don dam gyi sgo nas lan 'debs so/

/'dir bden pa gnyis la don dam bden pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang bzhin spros bral gang zhig yongs gcod du shes brjod gzhal bya las 'das pa/ dbye na/ rnam grangs pa'i don dam dang rnam grangs ma yin pa'i don dam gnyis/ dang po ni/ skye med 'gag med sogs te don dam dang cha mthun pa'i phyir don dam du btags so/ /gnyis pa ni/ spros pa thams cad bral bas te don dam mtshan nyid pa'o/ /kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan nyid/ rten 'brel sna tshogs su snang ba/ dbye na/ yang dag pa'i dang log pa'i kun rdzob bo/ /dang po ni/ snang ba ltar gyi don byed nus pa gnod pa med pa'i dbang shes drug gi yul lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ snang ba ltar don byed mi nus pa gnod pa dang bcas pa'i dpe drug gi yul lta bu'o/ /de ni dbu ma'i lugs kyi yin la/ sems tsam lugs kyi don dam pa bden pa'i mtshan nyid/ chos gang zhig rigs pas dpyad bzod pa/ kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan nyid/ chos gang zhig rigs pas dpyad mi bzod pa/ mdo sde pa'i lugs kyi don dam bden pa'i mtshan nyid| blo ma 'khrul ba'i yul du bden pa/ kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan nyid| blo 'khrul ba'i yul du bden pa/ 'di'i blo ma 'khrul ba ni 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag yin la gong gi rigs pa'ang don dam dpyod pa'i rigs pa'o/ /bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs kyi don dam bden pa'i mtshan nyid/ chos gang zhig bcom gzhig gis de'i blo mi 'dor ba/ kun rdzob bden pa'i mtshan nyid/ bcom gzhig gis de'i blo 'dor ba/ phyi rol pa'i bden gnyis kyi 'dod tshul 'dir ma yin pa'i phyir 'dir ma bkod do/ /legs bshad 'od brgya ldan pa'i rta bdun can| |log par rtog pa'i tshang tshing sreg pa 'di/ /phrag dog phyogs 'dzin mun khung gnas rnams kyis/ /mthong ba min yang gzu bo'i blo rgyas byed/ /skabs lnga pa'i don bsdus pa legs par bshad zin to// // skabs drug pa/ mthar gyis sbyor ba bshad pa/
